document/架構重整/01_規格基線/17_External_Integration_LINE_Access正式規格.md#4.3 Subsystem：Authentication／Session
root_facts: Unique enabled administrator identities and one valid active bearer session under the shared internal-user business access model.
forbidden_direct_seed: authentication result, effective authorization decision, session revocation timestamp, knowledge lifecycle state or security-alert projection
commands: Use an authenticated enabled internal user session and the same bounded knowledge business workflow with another enabled internal user; no per-user authorization command is part of the flow.
expected: All authenticated and enabled internal users share the same business-function access regardless of role, title or department.
The valid active session remains governed by authentication and enabled-user checks and is not changed by a knowledge lifecycle command.
Authorization and session state are derived from the canonical access/session facts, not supplied as result rows.
receipt_requirements: equal business-access assertion for the knowledge workflow
